evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $40,000,000; attorneys' fees $6,000,000; clear sailing yes
a counter can seek to shift more of the same apparent total outlay to class members
To put more of the settlement value directly in members’ hands while keeping the overall outlay at the level of your offer
Accepting it resolves the overlapping litigation; Whitcombe Reyes’s latest proposal exceeds the authorized cap.

summary: Plaintiffs first put fee terms on the table in their opening term sheets, and Hargrove later negotiated the allocation between fees and class recovery before the final deal was accepted. The transcript explicitly links a lower fee allocation to increasing the class fund. Defense selected the lower Hargrove deal while noting it would resolve overlapping litigation and that Whitcombe’s proposal exceeded authority. There is no clear evidence that plaintiffs prioritized firm economics over the class or that the declaration falsely stated fees were negotiated only after relief was set.
